sFISCAL NOTE
House Bill 269
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/15/2023
House Bill 269 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the local boards of education to adopt policies regarding long-term suspension
or expulsion.
